title: Greg Eghigian researching his UFO history book at the archive

tellings.quote: he spent a couple of weeks here uh

plain: The historian Greg Eghigian, according to the Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, spent "a couple of weeks" at Svahn's archive in Sweden while researching his book on the history of UFOs. Svahn, who keeps the archive, tells Michels this as something he saw himself, as a sign of how much material the collection holds.
